subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a unified core admin inventory for WhatsApp contacts and permissions, or should this remain limited to narrower pairing/allowlist management surfaces?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent product shape affects security-sensitive contact data, CLI namespace, account scoping, last-active persistence, and overlap with `/allowlist` and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621.

options.title: Design unified admin inventory
options.body: Create a single account-scoped CLI/UI concept for contact authorization rows that merges config allowlists, pairing-store approvals, directory names, and activity metadata with redaction rules.

options.title: Narrow to approved-pairing commands
options.body: Handle only list-approved and revoke through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 and defer broader permission/activity inventory until a separate product decision.

options.title: Defer core surface
options.body: Keep management in existing config and `/allowlist` flows until maintainers choose a broader admin model or plugin/API boundary.

recommendation.title: Design unified admin inventory
recommendation.body: Create a single account-scoped CLI/UI concept for contact authorization rows that merges config allowlists, pairing-store approvals, directory names, and activity metadata with redaction rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest nearby history across pairing store, CLI helper docs, config mutation, and `/allowlist` surfaces.
